install:
npm ci || npm install
if ! command -v gcloud >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL https://dl.google.com/dl/cloudsdk/channels/rapid/downloads/google-cloud-cli-linux-x86_64.tar.gz -o /tmp/google-cloud-cli.tar.gz
  mkdir -p "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk-root"
  tar -xzf /tmp/google-cloud-cli.tar.gz -C "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk-root"
  "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk-root/google-cloud-sdk/install.sh" --quiet --path-update true --usage-reporting false --command-completion false
  echo 'export PATH="$HOME/google-cloud-sdk-root/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
  export PATH="$HOME/google-cloud-sdk-root/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH"
fi
gcloud version
